name: Adonijah
summary: The fourth son of David, born to Haggith. He tried to make himself king as David grew old, but Solomon was crowned instead, and Adonijah later lost his life.

key_moments.title: Adonijah Claims the Throne
key_moments.description: Adonijah gathered chariots and horsemen and said he would be king. Joab and Abiathar the priest helped him, and he held a feast by the stone of Zoheleth near En-rogel.

key_moments.title: Holding the Altar's Horns
key_moments.description: At his feast Adonijah heard that David had made Solomon king, and his guests ran off. Afraid of Solomon, he took hold of the horns of the altar, and Solomon sent him home, sparing him as long as no wickedness was found in him.

key_moments.title: Asks for Abishag as His Wife
key_moments.description: Adonijah asked Bathsheba to have Solomon give him Abishag the Shunammite as his wife. Solomon said this was like asking for the kingdom, and he sent Benaiah to put Adonijah to death.
